name: Sheraton Grand Hotel and Spa
insider_take: A grand Victorian railway hotel transformed into Edinburgh's most prestigious address, where Scottish heritage meets modern luxury in the heart of the Old Town.
whats_special: Built in 1902 as the North British Hotel, this iconic property sits directly above Edinburgh Waverley Station and features the famous Balmoral Clock - deliberately set 2 minutes fast to ensure travelers never miss their trains. The hotel's One Square restaurant boasts a Michelin star, and its location offers unparalleled views of Edinburgh Castle and the Royal Mile.
pro_tip: Book a Castle View room on higher floors for spectacular sunrise views over Edinburgh Castle, and time your arrival during the Edinburgh Festival (August) when the city transforms into the world's largest arts festival.
dont_miss: The hotel's ESPA spa treatments featuring Scottish-inspired rituals, afternoon tea in the Palm Court with views of Princes Street, and the short walk to the Royal Mile where you can explore 1,000 years of Scottish history. The hotel is also perfectly positioned for the nightly Edinburgh Castle military tattoo during festival season.
pros: Prime location on Princes Street with views of Edinburgh Castle
Historic grand hotel with elegant Victorian architecture
Walking distance to Royal Mile and major attractions
cons: Premium pricing for central Edinburgh location
Busy tourist area with heavy foot traffic
